HR-only CSV export
post.description: UTF-8 CSV with BOM, CRLF and RFC 4180 quoting; text starting with = + - @ tab, CR or LF is prefixed with an apostrophe; money in rupees with two decimals. At most 10,000 rows: X-Report-Truncated says whether rows were left out and X-Report-Row-Count gives the rows written (no note row is added). Each export writes one audit row and outbox event with the dataset, column keys and filter operators only. Limited to 10 exports per minute per person.
